channel.title: Liu Lab news
channel.description: News from Liu Lab at Peking University.

item.title: A lab hike and dinner together
item.description: The whole lab set off for an intense 3.5-hour hike, scrambling up the mountain together and cheering each other to the top. We capped the day with a well-earned lab dinner — tired legs, big appetites, and great company.

item.title: Happy Teachers' Day
item.description: Marking Teachers' Day with the students.

item.title: Jörg Enderlein visits PKU
item.description: Great to welcome Prof. Jörg Enderlein (Third Institute of Physics – Biophysics, University of Göttingen) for a seminar on "Advanced Concepts of Super-Resolution Fluorescence Microscopy," spanning Image Scanning Microscopy (ISM) and metal- and graphene-induced energy transfer (MIET/GIET) imaging.

item.title: Johan Hofkens and Elke Debroye visit PKU
item.description: Great to welcome Prof. Johan Hofkens and Dr. Elke Debroye from KU Leuven for a pair of seminars on campus. Prof. Hofkens (KU Leuven and the Max Planck Institute for Polymer Research) spoke on "Chemistry Driven Microscopy: from improved imaging to applications," and Dr. Elke Debroye (Associate Professor, KU Leuven) followed with "Shedding Light on Perovskites: Spectroscopic Insights into Stable Optoelectronics."

item.title: Prof. Per Uhlén visits PKU
item.description: Great to have Prof. Per Uhlén (Karolinska Institutet) visit the PKU campus for an afternoon of science with students — a round-table discussion around his talk, "Seeing is Believing: Exploring Whole-Brain RNA Transcripts in Three Dimensions."

item.title: On the Great Wall with Prof. Fernando D. Stefani
item.description: The day after his seminar, the lab took Prof. Fernando D. Stefani out to the Great Wall for a day away from the microscopes.

item.title: Prof. Fernando D. Stefani visits NBIC
item.description: Prof. Fernando D. Stefani — of CIBION–CONICET and the University of Buenos Aires — was invited to the National Biomedical Imaging Center, where he gave a talk titled "Fluorescence Nanoscopy and Single Molecule Tracking with True Nanometric Resolution: STED-FRET, MINFLUX and Other Ways."

item.title: A lab trip to Datong
item.description: The lab headed to Datong, in Shanxi, for a weekend away — the old city walls, its temples and grottoes, and a group photo dressed up as the local paper's front page.

item.title: A lab dinner to welcome the Chinese New Year
item.description: Ahead of the Spring Festival, the whole lab came together for a New Year dinner — a warm evening of good food and good company to close out the year and welcome the one ahead.

item.title: The 3rd Sino–France Joint Meeting on BioImaging
item.description: The lab took part in the 3rd Sino–France Joint Meeting on BioImaging, held in Huairou, bringing together biomedical imaging groups from China and France.

item.title: At the French Embassy: 30 years of CNRS in China
item.description: The lab joined a reception at the French Embassy in China celebrating 30 years of CNRS — France's national centre for scientific research — in China, together with the ambassador and visiting scientists from France.

item.title: A lab day at Universal Studios Beijing
item.description: The students took a day off together for a trip to Universal Studios Beijing.

item.title: Installing our Leica SP8 FLIM in Huairou
item.description: Our Leica SP8 FLIM confocal microscope being installed at the Huairou lab — another instrument online.

item.title: Onur Dagliyan visits Beijing
item.description: So good to have our friend Onur Dagliyan in Beijing — in town for the Huairou Forum, and around for dinner and good conversation.

item.title: Our imaging facility passes national acceptance
item.description: Celebrating the national acceptance of the Multi-modal Cross-scale Biomedical Imaging Facility, in Huairou — the milestone that carries our work, and one that even featured on the national evening news. We are officially setting sail.

item.title: Presenting at ChemoRevolution
item.description: The lab presented at ChemoRevolution — "Chem Revolution: From Enabling Tools to Enlightening Discoveries" — with an oral talk from Bei Liu and posters from the students.

item.title: Lab retreat together with Huang lab
item.description: To celebrate the ending of spring semester and the first year of Liu lab, we organized a joint lab retreat with Xiaoshuai Huang lab. Lots of fun!

item.title: Awards!
item.description: Congratulations to Peiyang and Jiaxin, who won the Best Poster Award at the Advanced Imaging for Cell Discovery meeting.

item.title: Advanced Imaging for Cell Discovery, Hefei
item.description: The lab travelled to Hefei, Anhui for the Advanced Imaging for Cell Discovery meeting.

item.title: Catching the tail end of winter — Huaibei Ski
item.description: To celebrate the beginning of the coming semester, the Liu lab went skiing and then HOTPOT afterward, together with other FOUR labs! Much fun. :))

item.title: Happy New Year
item.description: We celebrated the New Year together with the Sun lab (Sun He). Looking forward to more collaborations ahead — and hot pot is always the students' first choice.

item.title: Our air table arrived before New Year's Day
item.description: Our optical air table arrived just before New Year's Day — the groundwork for the microscopes to come.

item.title: Skating on Weiming Lake, PKU
item.description: What an event for Christmas! COVID is all behind us.

item.title: Our first microscope just arrived!
item.description: After a long wait, we finally received our first microscope - though a tiny one. There was lots of fun showing the students how to assemble a microscope from scratch. (The Olympus engineer couldn't come to campus...) Hope supply chains can return to normal soon...

item.title: A lab outing to the Great Wall and Hongluo Temple
item.description: An early lab outing — a day at the Mutianyu Great Wall and Hongluo Temple.

item.title: At the NBIC completion ceremony and the 2nd Huairou Forum
item.description: The lab took part in the completion ceremony of the National Biomedical Imaging Center and the 2nd Huairou Forum.

item.title: The Liu Lab is founded
item.description: The Liu Lab officially began on 8 August 2022. We set out to build next-generation imaging and genetic tools to understand the mysteries of life.
